title: Gatsibo students’ protest/refusal to attend classes at Gakoni Adventist College (adjacent-month lead)
reason: Out of January scope: the report dates students refusing classes to 8 February 2021; it does not report a January onset or January continuation.
notes: The article describes a school expulsion dispute, a police removal on 6 February, and students refusing classes unless the student returned. It reports 16 arrests and a school enrollment of 372, neither of which establishes the number assembled. The described grievance concerns school administration; a demand to Rwanda’s government or its policy is not clearly established. Retain as a February-unit follow-up lead.

title: Gashora refugee-camp demonstration over COVID-related living conditions (retrospective out-of-month lead)
reason: Out of January scope: the opened retrospective account dates the Gashora demonstration to 15 April 2020; no continuation into January 2021 is reported.
notes: The UK Home Office note reproduces an ACLED entry about refugees recently transferred from Libya protesting camp living conditions under coronavirus restrictions, with police intervention. Turnout, specific demand recipient, and physical end are not established by the accessed passage. The separate Wikipedia snippet’s claim of about 300 and stay-at-home orders may refer to this event, but identity is not verified.
